nodes.summary: The oriented edge boundary `∂S = {(x, x ± e_i) : x ∈ S, x ± e_i ∉ S}` of a finite set `S ⊆ ℤ^d`, as ordered pairs (inner endpoint first).
nodes.title: Oriented edge boundary of a finite lattice set

nodes.summary: The edge boundary of `S` has at most `2d |S|` elements.
nodes.title: Size bound for the edge boundary

nodes.summary: The probability `ℙ_p(0 ↔ x inside S)` that the origin and `x` are joined by an open path using only vertices of `S`; it is `0` if `0 ∉ S` or `x ∉ S`.
nodes.title: Probability of connection inside a set

nodes.summary: The site `x + δ e_i` obtained by moving `x` by `δ` in coordinate `i`.
nodes.title: Shift of a lattice site in one coordinate

nodes.summary: The Duminil-Copin–Tassion quantity `φ_p(S) = p ∑_{(x, y) ∈ ∂S} ℙ_p(0 ↔ x inside S)`.
nodes.title: Duminil-Copin–Tassion quantity
Sign of a unit lattice step

nodes.summary: The set of densities `p ∈ [0, 1]` for which some finite `S ∋ 0` has `φ_p(S) < 1`.
nodes.title: Densities with a finite set of small Duminil-Copin–Tassion quantity

nodes.summary: The Duminil-Copin–Tassion threshold `p̃_c(d) = sup {p : ∃ S ∋ 0 finite, φ_p(S) < 1}`.
nodes.title: Duminil-Copin–Tassion threshold

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
